new_value: Fixed in python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py: render_post validates ts and timeout_s types (must be int/float, bool rejected, floats must be finite via math.isfinite; None rejected) plus ts >= 0. Malformed values get 4.00 Bad Request and are never stored, so _prune_expired's now - started arithmetic can no longer hit TypeError. Verified directly: {ts:'bad'}, ts=None, timeout_s=None all rejected, _prune_expired runs clean, resource remains functional.
